opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit granted.
Messrs. William V. Hodges and Frank C. Nicodemus, Jr. for the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Co., and Messrs. Edward E. Watts, Jr. and Peter H. Holme for the City Bank Farmers Trust Co., respondents.
Reported below: 150 F. 2d 28.

attorneys: Acting Solicitor General Judson, Messrs. John W. Davis, Edwin S. S. Sunderland, James L. Homire, Thomas O’G. FitzGibbon, Judson C. McLester, Jr., Henry W. Anderson, George D. Gibson, W. A. W. Stewart, Arthur A. Gammell, John W. Drye, Jr. and George L. Shearer for petitioners.

Messrs. William V. Hodges and Frank C. Nicodemus, Jr. for the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Co., and Messrs. Edward E. Watts, Jr. and Peter H. Holme for the City Bank Farmers Trust Co., respondents.
